cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Let's pack your paintings for the last gallery. You've finally picked up a brush again. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If the big gallery rejected me too, I'm done. Did they write?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Their letter can wait. This gallery still needs your best three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Pick them, then. I can't face another envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the envelopes. You finish the blue one; there's still somewhere for it to go.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 puts off the gallery letter and A5 takes envelopes, but discouraging contents are only inferred; A3 status declaration supplies no actual adjustment until the ending.

relationship.evidence: B2 threatens to give up and B4 delegates selection because envelopes are painful.

heightening.evidence: B4 delegation causes A5 to handle correspondence while keeping B painting.

specificity.evidence: A1 last gallery and renewed painting establish thin hope; B2 makes the quitting risk explicit.

brevityWit.evidence: A1 voluntary please and A3 authority phrase are detached from the practical packing task.
